roadSource.description: Geofabrik Switzerland 2026-09-02 plus OSM border extract retrieved 2026-09-08

selection: Seventeen remaining bus routes with at most eight unmatched directed pairs on Friday, excluding the already reviewed Thun 2 coordinate conflict. Entire candidate patterns from both dates, including spillover and out-of-canton calls, are matched. Existing successful geometry is retained.
roadRule: Only missing directed pairs with an existing official operator/mode/line crosswalk. All full-pattern contexts must provide a valid identical path under 80 m snap and max(1200 m, 4.5 times direct distance). No stop relocation, clipped calls, arbitrary gap bridge, or assertion of observed or operator-certified physical direction.
